title: Evaluating the Repeatability of Friction Coefficient Measurements and Tactile Perceptions in Skin–Textile Interactions Across Body Regions
extraction_note: Numeric facts manually transcribed from abstract/section 3.2 and Tables 1–2; no individual data or graph digitization.
role: Conditioned skin-cotton cohort friction estimates; explicit contact solver input
limitations: Cohort means and reported SD, not individual predictions or Bayesian posteriors.
No raw participant observations, coefficient covariance, wet-condition law or speed/load response surface.
Other four friction regions appear graphically only and are not digitized here.
PlaneContact uses these means as explicit Coulomb inputs; transfer to cloth contact remains an assumption.
